gates.ort_1_22_1_direct_run: not_run_this_delegation (permission-denied isolated package dir; risk considered low, see risks)

changes_from_v1: Removed the 400-byte label_flat 1D plane and the 1,600-byte INT32 src_idx 20x20 plane by replacing the single flat-index Gather for the key-stamp with two separable Gathers: Gather(label, src_r_vec, axis=2) then Gather(row_gathered, src_c_vec, axis=3). Mathematically identical to the v1 flat-index Gather because src_r depends only on row offset/scale and src_c only on column offset/scale, and clip order/points are preserved exactly.

Applied the same row/col-separable 2-step Gather to the 3x5 scale-detection kernel_label sample (removed sample_idx, kept label_flat-free), preserving the v1 asymmetric clipping (only sc is clipped, sr is not, matching v1 exactly).

Attempted (then reverted) casting non4_u8 and the four row/col indicator vectors from FLOAT32 to UINT8 to shrink the Einsum operands feeding the row/col template and side summaries; reverted because ORT's Einsum kernel does not implement uint8/int8/int16 (NOT_IMPLEMENTED at session creation). No net effect on v2 vs v1 for that portion (kept FLOAT32, identical to v1).
unremovable_planes_reported: label_f (FLOAT32 Conv output, 1600B): Conv only supports float/double/float16 inputs in ONNX, so this plane is structurally unavoidable.
mask4 (BOOL, 400B) + mask4_u8 (UINT8, 400B): ReduceMax/ReduceMin do not support BOOL tensors in opset 17, so the Equal->Cast pair is unavoidable and already at the 1-byte-per-element floor.
indicator (BOOL, 400B) + indicator_u8 (UINT8, 400B): QLinearConv requires a UINT8/INT8 input, so the Equal->Cast pair feeding the vote convolution is unavoidable.

non4_u8 and its 4 row/col FLOAT32 Cast/Einsum-adjacent vectors: could not be shrunk below FLOAT32 (4 bytes/elem) because ORT's Einsum kernel only implements float/double/int32/int64; uint8/int8/int16 fail with NOT_IMPLEMENTED (measured).

vote (UINT8, 400B) plus fit2d/vote_masked/stamp_valid/corners/out_bbox (BOOL, 400B each) and their paired Where outputs (UINT8, 400B each): each is already at the 1-byte-per-element floor for a 20x20 plane and is consumed by exactly one downstream masking/select op; no further pairwise fusion found without changing task semantics.
out_label30 (UINT8 padded 30x30, 900B): required as the pre-output crop-to-canvas plane before the final Equal-to-one-hot; already minimal at 1 byte/elem.
risks: ORT 1.22.1 was not run directly in this delegation because the pre-existing isolated .ort122-packages directory returned Permission denied to this worker; risk assessed as low since v2 uses the exact same operator/dtype set as v1 (already verified on ORT 1.22.1 with 266/266 examples), but this is an unverified extrapolation, not a measurement.

The uint8 Einsum optimization attempt is documented as a negative result (ORT NOT_IMPLEMENTED); a future worker should not re-attempt it without first checking ORT kernel support for the target opset/EP.

12,500 target (gain > 0.80) was not reached; remaining 20x20 planes are, per the analysis above, each already at the 1-byte/1600-byte structural floor for their op semantics (Conv float output, BOOL<->UINT8 cast pairs required by ReduceMax/QLinearConv, Einsum float requirement) — further reduction would likely require changing the underlying algorithm, which is outside this worker's authority.
